{{Top|leg}}
The '''Commenor Militia''' was a military force that guarded [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. During the days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Militia pilots flew [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. It was during that time that [[Feylis Ardele]] served in the Commenor Militia.<ref name="Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
